response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.state, '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share_percent FROM player_college pc INNER JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state, '') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

assumptions.assumption: "share" is expressed as a percentage (0–100) rather than a decimal fraction (0–1)

alternatives.sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.state, '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share_fraction FROM player_college pc INNER JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state, '') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
